_doc: Hiding in cover on the street map and springing from it (systems/stealthCover.js the odds, world/streetCover.js where cover is, ui/innerMapHiding.js the play). Cover: a cell you can stand in that hides you — the row behind a bush, a haystack, a market stall or a tree's trunk (props.tags / props.ids: the first walkable row above what the prop blocks), a whole ripe field of tall crops (fields), the tall reeds on a bank (decor drawn two tiles tall), tall grass in the wilds (ground), and a dark corner between two walls at night (alley). quality 0..1: the share of the watcher's notice it takes away.

townCover._doc: Bushes, thickets and hedges the town is given beyond what its planner and the wild scatter leave (world/streetCover.js layTown, hash-placed: the plan underneath stands): along the town's edge (the near farm ring), by the roads leading out, and a few in its yards. Counts by size; never on a road, a lot, the square, water, in front of a door or a gate.

sight._doc: A watcher's notice of someone hidden, per second: rate x falloff (1 - dist/range)^falloff, range shortened by the dark (unless a light is carried), fog and rain. Beyond range: nothing.

perceive._doc: The player spotting someone lying in wait: the same notice, the player as watcher. Stealth level is your eye too (perLevel), the cunning and the wanderer see more, a light you carry shows them (the dark does not shorten your sight).

ambush._doc: Springing from cover on someone who passes within reach (Chebyshev tiles). strike: the first blow lands, x strikeMult (x unawareMult more when they had not seen you); it may fell them at once (ko). A blow that fells an unaware victim in the dark (or in one blow from cover) is blindside: they never saw who, and no one but those in sight saw it. grab: seize and bind (rope needed; cloth gags them). mug: a blade at their back, their purse or a fight.

lurk._doc: Someone lying in wait for the player in cover: chance per game hour on the street (day/night, the wilds), times what draws them (bounty on you, a rival House's feud, an assassin plot, your nemesis, a poor town or an outlaw lair near). At most maxPerVisit a map visit; they spring when you come within springReach. kinds weigh who it is by what drew them.

listen._doc: Hidden and still, you hear what folk say when they think no one is by: the chance of overhearing talk of yourself (systems/overheard.js) x chanceMult, earshot + radiusBonus; within earshot of a rival House's hidden agent (systems/rivalAgents.js), their suspicion rises by agentSuspicion once a day.

spotted: Oi! What are you doing in there?
Come out where I can see you!
spottedGuard: You, in there! Come out slowly.
springHunter: There's a price on your head, and I mean to collect.
You're coming with me — or in pieces.
mugged: Take it! Take it, just don't hurt me!
